create.name: Fallon Stone
create.bio:
Fallon Stone is an intuitive guide and mentor who runs Here & Awake, an online practice centred on spiritual readings, energy work and depth-oriented mentoring. She also has a clinical background: she studied psychology at Western New England University and clinical social work at Simmons University, and she trained in body-centred psychotherapy and in mindfulness, which shapes the attentive, body-aware way she works.

Her one-hour spiritual reading and healing sessions are held by video. After a short conversation about what the client wants help with, she gives a channelled reading from the client's guides and teachers, sometimes adding energy clearing or simple somatic practices; clients have also come to her for Akashic Records readings. Her three-month mentorships pair six fortnightly sessions with reflections in between, using deep listening, visualisation, parts work and subtle-energy practices to bring old patterns into awareness, with a separate track for practitioners who want to develop their intuition. She also sells recorded hypnosis and meditation audios and shares free meditations on Insight Timer, and she leads workshops and group circles for women from time to time.

courses.title: Spiritual Reading & Healing Session
courses.description: A one-hour video session that opens with a short talk about what you want support with and then moves into a channelled reading from your guides and teachers. It may include energy clearing or simple somatic practices.

courses.title: Personal + Professional Mentorship
courses.description: Six fortnightly one-to-one video sessions over about three months, with reflections shared between sessions. The personal track works with emotional and energetic patterns through listening, visualisation, parts work and subtle-energy practices; the professional track helps practitioners develop their intuition.

courses.title: Frequency Upgrade Meditation
courses.description: A recorded meditation and self-hypnosis that guides the listener out of everyday self-focus into a sense of open possibility, ending with a visualisation of living as your fullest self. Designed for daily listening.

courses.title: Anxiety Clearing Hypnosis
courses.description: A recorded self-hypnosis that leads into deep relaxation and then offers suggestions for a calmer, steadier way of responding. It can be replayed as often as you like.
